post.text:
An American F/A-18F crashed while attempting to land on the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln after returning from bombing Iran.
The arresting gear failed to deploy, causing the plane to fall into the water. The pilot was rescued. https://t.co/GuTk9MU37L
